title: The installation takes on a new job
lede: A simulated robot installation with one robot policy that never changes, and agents that improve the installation around it. Story A: a shift lead asks for one job; three shifts of an agent investigate it, each starting from the last one's checks and skills, and the saved job runs on reserved starts beside the naive chain. Story B: an agent builds a measurement on a robot fleet, and its saved probe recipe is used again on a later fleet. Every clip and number resolves to a recorded run.
